statement: This synthetic IMP/IMS is an evidence-calibrated experimental model created for the Predictive Program Management 2.0 capstone. It is not an actual or reconstructed F-35 contractor schedule.

freeze.change_policy: No further changes to durations, float, scenario magnitudes, predecessor logic or policy values unless a genuine implementation defect is found; any such fix must be recorded here.
decisions: INTERVENTION_2 stays based on DISTURBANCE_1 (mission-system software delay): resequencing lets test content that does not need the delayed mission-system capability proceed after the A405 readiness gate.

purpose: Provides a structured, inspectable program schedule for the later DSM, WTM and forward-simulation stages. The public JSF corpus contains no contractor IMP/IMS, so a synthetic one is needed to demonstrate those methods; its dependency themes are calibrated against evidence retrieved from that corpus.
not_a_reconstruction: Not an actual, leaked or reconstructed F-35 contractor IMP/IMS. No historical accuracy is claimed for any activity, duration, sequence, date or outcome.
separation_from_corpus: Stored in data/synthetic/ only. Not placed in data/raw/jsf, not ingested, not embedded and not in the vector store; RAG ingestion is manifest-driven and no manifest references these files.

provenance_classes.OBSERVED: Directly supported by public F-35 source documentation. Used only in observed_evidence below.
provenance_classes.DERIVED: An analytical dependency or relationship inferred from observed evidence. Used for dependency concepts and DSM node groupings.
provenance_classes.SYNTHETIC: A duration, schedule position, activity structure, disturbance, intervention or simulated outcome created for the capstone demonstration. Every IMS activity, IMP event, scenario and dependency implementation is SYNTHETIC.

classification_rules: IMS activities and IMP events: data_classification SYNTHETIC; evidence_basis names the observed theme, if any.

Dependencies: data_classification is DERIVED (concept inferred from Q01/Q04/Q07/Q08 evidence) or SYNTHETIC (generic sequencing); implementation_classification is always SYNTHETIC because the exact activity-to-activity link is invented.
No dependency or activity is OBSERVED: the corpus states relationships between program themes, not between these activities.
Scenarios and all their magnitudes: SYNTHETIC.

support_labels.EXPLICIT_PASSAGE: At least one passage recorded in the project's evaluation outputs states the relationship concept directly.
support_labels.FRAGMENTARY: The concept is assembled from separate fragments across passages or documents; no single passage states it.
support_labels.NOT_APPLICABLE: Synthetic sequencing; no corpus support is claimed.

rework_indicators.CORRECTIVE: Planned correction of deficiencies found upstream (outside the explicit loop).
rework_indicators.LOOP: Member of the explicit flight-test rework loop A410 -> A415 -> A420 -> A425 (-> A410).

conventions.time: Relative workdays from synthetic day 0; finish = start + duration. No calendar dates.
conventions.total_float: baseline_total_float = latest start - earliest start against the network finish (backward pass).
conventions.status: Planned baseline only: percent_complete 0 and forecast equals baseline.
conventions.rework_loop: A410 -> A415 -> A420 -> A425 are finish-to-start links; A425 -> A410 is recorded once as FEEDBACK_REWORK and excluded from predecessor_ids, so the baseline validates as acyclic.
conventions.agentic_activity_mapping: Agentic Phase 1 MVP pairs map to DSM nodes: A1 -> D4, A2 / A4 -> D6, A3 -> D5, A5 -> D7, A6 -> D8.

observed_evidence.summary: Mission-system software experienced delays that affected flight-test progress.
Mission-systems software tending towards familiar historical patterns of extended development, discovery in flight test, and deferrals to later increments.
Software behind schedule; may delay first mission-system flight test.
Flight tests hampered, as in prior years, by the late delivery of test aircraft.
Continuing effects from late delivery of test aircraft substantially reduced accomplishments.
Delays in delivering test aircraft are expected to hamper and further compress test schedules.
Redesign efforts to address weight growth was the single largest factor causing the $10 billion cost increase and 18-month extension in the development schedule.
Weight problems found during system integration and design review led to the 2004 rebaseline and schedule extension.
STOVL weight-driven design changes affected key performance parameters; the other variants' designs were affected as well.
The first flight-test aircraft would not include the weight-reduction design changes and so would not represent the production configuration.
The re-plan to address weight added $7 billion and 18 months (differs from GAO-08-388's $10 billion; not reconciled).
Concurrency risks: at the LRIP decision less than 1 percent of the test program will have been completed.
The JSF was planned to be significantly more concurrent than the F-22A.
A highly concurrent approach that makes significant investments in manufacturing capabilities and production aircraft before flight testing demonstrates performance.
Problems found may require redesign, production-line changes, and retrofit expenses for aircraft already built.

Q01.question: What evidence indicates that mission-system software maturity affected F-35 flight-test execution?
Q01.derived_concept: Mission-System Software Maturity -> Flight-Test Execution (D4 -> D6)
Q01.agentic_phase1_result: PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED (DIRECT 70.5, near-tied with INDIRECT; single REAL_LLM_MODE run)
Q01.how_it_informed: Software integration activities (A205-A230) gate the flight-test readiness review (A230 -> A405); discovery in flight test motivates the explicit rework loop; DISTURBANCE_1, INTERVENTION_1 and INTERVENTION_2 act on this path.

Q04.question: What evidence describes how late delivery or limited availability of F-35 test aircraft constrained the sequence or pace of flight testing?
Q04.agentic_phase1_result: UNRESOLVED (best DIRECT 69.5, 0.5 below threshold; single run)
Q04.how_it_informed: A dedicated test-aircraft chain (A300-A325) gates the readiness review (A325 -> A405); this chain controls A405 at baseline; motivates DISTURBANCE_2.

Q07.question: What evidence shows that F-35 aircraft weight growth caused redesign or schedule consequences?
Q07.derived_concept: Weight / redesign -> downstream cost / schedule exposure (D3 -> D8; also D3 -> D2 -> D5)
Q07.agentic_phase1_result: Not run as an agentic case. Retrieval found one explicit passage; the rest of the chain is fragmentary.
Q07.how_it_informed: Weight assessment, margin evaluation and correction (A125-A135) sit on the design path; the redesign feeds test-aircraft configuration (A145 -> A305) and residual rework exposure (A135 -> A515).

Q08.question: What evidence describes dependencies between F-35 development testing and production decisions (development-test-production concurrency)?
Q08.derived_concept: Development / Test Maturity -> Production Commitment / Rework Exposure (D7 -> D8)
Q08.how_it_informed: Long-lead commitment (A505) deliberately precedes flight-test maturity (concurrency); the readiness assessment waits for A430 (A430 -> A510); late corrections feed rework exposure (A420 -> A515); INTERVENTION_3 stages the commitment (40% before / 60% after A430) without removing concurrency.

synthetic_values: All 35 activities: their definitions, workstream / IMP / DSM assignment, durations, predecessors and risk states
All 8 IMP event definitions and completion criteria
Every baseline / forecast start and finish (computed from synthetic durations)
Every activity-to-activity dependency link, type and lag
All scenario disturbances and intervention values (A210 +8, A305 +4, A210 -4, delay_absorption_days 4, commitment fractions 0.40 / 0.60)
The software-path float calibration (A205 duration 66, giving A230 total float 4)

design_calibrations.software_path_float: A205 was lengthened from 40 to 66 workdays so the software chain reaches the A405 readiness gate with 4 workdays of total float instead of 30. The path is near-critical but does not control the baseline finish; an 8-workday A210 disturbance consumes the float and then propagates, so the 4-workday recovery is decision-relevant. Selected for the proof of concept, not to reproduce F-35 schedule performance. No evidence-derived relationship was changed.
design_calibrations.resequencing_after_readiness: INTERVENTION_2 keeps every A405 predecessor. Readiness is a gate: resequencing only reorders flight-test content after A405, absorbing up to 4 workdays (delay_absorption_days) of the delay reaching A410.
design_calibrations.staged_production_commitment: INTERVENTION_3 keeps the baseline concurrency (A505 is not gated on A430). It limits pre-maturity commitment to 40% and gates the remaining 60% on A430, to compare full concurrent commitment with reduced pre-maturity exposure. The 40/60 split is a synthetic policy assumption, not historically derived.

limitations: Observed evidence is summarized from the project's evaluation outputs; page numbers are as recorded there and were not re-checked against the PDFs.
Support labels are the author's reading of retrieved passages, not human-annotated ground truth.
Agentic Phase 1 verdicts for Q01 / Q04 / Q08 were single runs within about 0.5 points of the threshold.
Cost figures for the weight re-plan differ between GAO-08-388 and GAO-11-325 and are not used quantitatively.
Durations are illustrative and not calibrated to any real program data.
